content.comment_body: Hello. I seem to have a similar issue—I’m attempting to connect my mobile device remotely. The [product_name] works fine when both are on the same WiFi network, but I can't access the [product_name] from the app when I'm outside. I read that remote access needs to be enabled, but I am unable to select that option. Only 'Allow App access' and 'Allow Web server access' options are available. DDNS is set up (since my IP isn't static) and port 8080 appears to be fine. Am I missing a step? Thanks

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unable to access a [product_name] device remotely from their app when outside their local WiFi network, despite local connectivity being successful. They cannot enable remote access settings beyond App and Web server access, although DDNS and port forwarding are in place.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to have uncomplicated remote access to the [product_name] through their mobile app, including activation of all necessary remote access settings regardless of network location.
